name: Coverity Scan

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 1 * * 1"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: coverity-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  COVERITY_PROJECT: IntelPython/dpctl
  ONEAPI_ROOT: /opt/intel/oneapi

jobs:
  coverity-scan:
    if: github.repository == 'IntelPython/dpctl'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 150

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # versioneer needs the tags to compute the package version
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Add Intel repository
        run: |
          wget -qO- https://apt.repos.intel.com/intel-gpg-keys/GPG-PUB-KEY-INTEL-SW-PRODUCTS.PUB \
            | gpg --dearmor | sudo tee /usr/share/keyrings/oneapi-archive-keyring.gpg > /dev/null
          echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/oneapi-archive-keyring.gpg] https://apt.repos.intel.com/oneapi all main" \
            | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/oneAPI.list
          sudo apt update

      - name: Install latest Intel OneAPI
        run: |
          sudo apt install intel-oneapi-compiler-dpcpp-cpp
          sudo apt install intel-oneapi-tbb
          sudo apt install intel-oneapi-umf
          sudo apt install hwloc

      - name: Install CMake and Ninja
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install ninja-build

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0 # v7.1.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          architecture: x64

      - name: Install dpctl dependencies
        run: |
          pip install numpy cython setuptools"<80" scikit-build cmake ninja versioneer[toml]==0.29

      - name: Report compiler version
        run: |
          source "${ONEAPI_ROOT}/setvars.sh"
          icpx --version

      - name: Download Coverity Build Tool
        timeout-minutes: 15
        env:
          COVERITY_SCAN_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.COVERITY_SCAN_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          curl --location --no-progress-meter --fail-with-body \
               --retry 5 --retry-connrefused --retry-delay 5 \
               --data-urlencode "token=${COVERITY_SCAN_TOKEN}" \
               --data-urlencode "project=${COVERITY_PROJECT}" \
               --output cov-analysis.tar.gz \
               https://scan.coverity.com/download/linux64
          mkdir -p cov-analysis
          tar -xzf cov-analysis.tar.gz --strip 1 -C cov-analysis
          echo "${PWD}/cov-analysis/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Configure Coverity for the DPC++ compiler
        run: |
          source "${ONEAPI_ROOT}/setvars.sh"
          cov-configure --gcc
          # Generic clang templates can't parse SYCL headers, see https://github.com/IntelPython/dpctl/pull/2401
          comptypes="$(cov-configure --list-compiler-types | cut -d, -f1)"
          comptype=""
          for candidate in intel_oneapi_icx intel_oneapi_icx:linux intel_icx:linux; do
            if grep -qxF "${candidate}" <<< "${comptypes}"; then
              comptype="${candidate}"
              break
            fi
          done
          if [ -z "${comptype}" ]; then
            echo "::error::No Intel oneAPI compiler type in this cov-analysis; refusing to fall back to the generic Clang configuration."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Using Coverity compiler type: ${comptype}"
          cov-configure --templ

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
